data_source: Local ATP CSV files from work/tennis-data; features use round_safe chronological snapshots because tourney_date is tournament start date.

legacy_contaminated_metrics_retired.reason: Previous production/backtest rows may have updated state between matches sharing the same tournament start date. Those metrics are no longer treated as scientific benchmarks.

promotion_source.selection_rule: strongest runtime-compatible corrected model selected from 2019-2023 walk-forward log loss, calibrated on 2024, benchmarked on 2025
